entities.summary: Ulises Blanch is a former American professional tennis player. He has a career high singles ranking of No. 236 achieved on 12 October 2020 and a doubles ranking of No. 423 achieved on 20 May 2019. His last match on the tour was in January 2025 and he has stated on his LinkedIn profile that he has retired due to injuries.
